verdict.rationale: Reimbursing employees in foreign currencies is a fair question for a corporate spend and banking platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no employee reimbursement or cross-border payout capability. It shows only domestic Brazilian payment rails (Pix, boletos, batch payments) and an international USD-balance account with IOF-free cards. That account is an adjacent feature, not local-currency reimbursement of employees abroad.
